# District 7 Elections

States of Jersey elections held in District 7 — St Saviour — since 2022:

- **[Deputies Elections](https://flow.je/elections/district-7#deputies)**

**[St Saviour Elections](https://flow.je/elections/st-saviour)**

* * *

* * *

## Deputies Elections

The 2022 elections are the first to utilise the new electoral districts.

* * *

### 2022 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (4 seats), 22nd June 2022.

**[Tom Binet](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/tom-binet), [Malcolm Ferey](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/malcolm-ferey), [Louise Doublet](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/louise-doublet), [Raluca Kovacs](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/raluca-kovacs) and [Philip Ozouf Jr](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-ozouf-jr) were elected as Deputies of District 7 in 2022.**

### 2026 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (4 seats), 7th June 2026.

- [Louise Doublet](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/louise-doublet) : Current Deputy of District 7 \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/14/deputy-launched-re-election-bid/)\]
- [Malcolm Ferey](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/malcolm-ferey) : Current Deputy of District 7 \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/02/12/malcolm-ferey-to-seek-re-election/)\]
- [Raluca Kovacs](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/raluca-kovacs) : Current Deputy of District 7 (Reform Jersey) \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/20/reform-jersey-deputy-to-seek-re-election-in-st-saviour/)\]
- [Chris Leck](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/chris-leck) : New Candidate \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/14/accountant-to-stand-in-st-saviour/)\]
